name: external_datasets_summary_v1
time: relative only: t_rel_ms = ms since the first sample of each animal-day; day = date as given; no absolute timestamp is kept

harmonise.rounding: nearest multiple of step_g, ties to even (numpy rint); the collar's exact rounding is [to verify]

harmonise_gravity: gravity_resting.csv has both quantise=True and quantise=False

windows.segment: consecutive samples of one animal-day with the same base class; a change of class, an unused sample, or a time step > 1000 ms starts a new segment
windows.window: fixed, non-overlapping, from the segment start, fully inside the segment
windows.strict: subset of valid windows with all 150 slots filled

rules: any value whose outcome is excluded:<reason> -> unused, <reason> (first such column in header order)
activities (all columns but Posture) giving two different base classes -> unused, conflict
one activity other than resting (moving, grazing, drinking) with Posture=Laying -> unused, posture_conflict
one activity -> its base class; Posture is context only (Ruminating + Laying -> resting)
no activity, Posture alone (Laying or Standing) -> resting

morales_vargas.shared_samples: deduplicated by (cow, Time); two different labels -> unused, shared_label_conflict

outputs: aggregated counts and means only; no per-sample rows, no per-window features
